lines.hook: What if the money in your pocket... suddenly became worthless?
lines.intro: Not a stock market dip. Your actual cash, losing value every single day. Here's how it would actually play out, step by step.
lines.relate: You know that feeling when your favorite snack quietly gets more expensive? Now imagine that happening every few hours.
lines.week1: Week one. A loaf of bread costs three dollars. By the end of the week, it's six. But your paycheck still says the same number.
lines.rush: So people get paid and rush to spend it all right away, because tomorrow it buys less. Shops change their prices twice a day.
lines.barter: Month two. Cash is basically paper. People start trading instead. Eggs for fuel, haircuts for vegetables.
lines.twist: But here's the crazy part. This has already happened. In Germany in 1923, prices doubled about every four days. And in Hungary in 1946, they doubled every fifteen hours.
lines.real: So could it really happen again? In 2009, Zimbabwe printed a one hundred trillion dollar note. A few months later, the country gave up on its own money completely.
lines.end: The fix? Countries start over with a new currency, and a central bank that isn't allowed to print money just to pay the bills. And slowly, trust comes back.
lines.cta: So be honest... what would you trade if money stopped working? Tell me in the comments.
